date: 2026-04-01
author: "Zhang Lab"
description: >
  Manhong Wang's paper maps the cultivable microbiota of broiler chicken
  ceca and enables targeted isolation of beneficial bacteria — a foundation
  for next-generation probiotics.
categories: [Publications]
---

Our culturomics study, led by Ph.D. student **Manhong Wang**, is out in
*Poultry Science*:

> Wang, M., Ye, X., Hsu, C.Y., Fugate, H., Zhang, X., Adhikari, P.A., Fan, P.,
> Elliott, K., Macklin, K., & Zhang, L. (2026). Application of culturomics to
> explore the cultivable microbiota and enable targeted bacterial isolation
> from the ceca of broiler chickens. *Poultry Science*, 105(4), 106527.
> [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.psj.2026.106527)

The work systematically cultures the broiler cecal microbiome — turning
"unculturable" community members into isolates we can actually study and
deploy. It is a key step toward identifying probiotic candidates that improve
poultry health and reduce pathogen colonization.
